sections.text: All Creation Serves as My Power

-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 620. Success value 100. 2x physical damage (Light).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Removes buffs.
-Target: all allies. Removes debuffs and special debuffs.
-Target: all allies. Removes status ailments.
-Target: all allies. Removes special status ailments.
-Target: yourself. Applies Ambush for 60 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; [Special] increases DEF and MDEF by 100%; reduces the cooldown time of Abilities to 0 (except for certain Abilities); nullifies Cost reduction and Unison gauge reduction. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Applies the following effect for 90 seconds: Recovers 10 Cost when using an Ability.
[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Applies the following effect for 90 seconds: Recovers 20% of max HP when using an Ability.
[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Applies the following effect for 90 seconds: Fills Unison gauge by 2 when using an Ability.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 and stat slot 2 by 40000
All Element Defense from Unison Damage +200
Only [Ruthless Aggressor] Paradox Zeus can be used as Unlocking Potential material
